lines: Today becomes the past, and I.
The sound of white and black, a withered throat.
The yesterday I seek, and your side.
The fact that I thought I could live again.
To me, who laments a life that can become nothing.
I think there was nothing to lose.
But there isn’t even anything I can’t give up.
I must have been a cold-hearted person.
Yet nothing I do can satisfy me.
Why do I still wish, I wonder.
I could think I wanted to keep living.
Perhaps just being alive let me smile.
The more I try to forget, the less I can forget.
I wound, cling, weep, struggle, and breathe?
I howl that it doesn’t matter.
Who is it that cannot die?
If you desire it, go after it.
And the scar you made proves you challenged.
No matter how you live, you’ll regret it.
I don’t mind a life that becomes nothing.
Even the act of writing to shape it,
Is because I still think I should live.
